scientific_question: Can a genuinely less brittle public-order source be formed by preregistered mild local perturbations of the unchanged 72-edge public graph while preserving enough F60 source feasibility for a fair prospectively evaluated learning task?
reason: F73/F74 extreme reverse/even_odd arrival orders reduce the exact F60 fair baseline to 0/16 or 0/8, so naive shifted curricula would violate the preexisting 25% fixed-control source-feasibility floor.

synthetic_cases.family_assignment: alternate -2 / -1 in ascending enumerated seed order

frozen_arrival_transforms.name: adjacent_swap
frozen_arrival_transforms.definition: for each consecutive pair of source event positions, swap their order; 36 swaps in total

frozen_arrival_transforms.name: local_rotate4
frozen_arrival_transforms.definition: for each consecutive fixed four-public-event block, rotate left by exactly one event

controls: original F60 fixed online (12 records x 12 bytes)
